meta.source: DocVex desktop app, Files tab (the project's local-folder explorer). Values read from src/styles/tokens.css, src/components/FilesWorkspace.css, src/styles/miniHeader.css, src/components/fileGlyph.jsx + .css, src/lib/folderColors.js and src/components/useMorphPill.css on 2026-09-25. Two themes: Cream (default, light) and Ink (dark). Runtime colour mixes are resolved to concrete values.
meta.units: px at a 16px root and app zoom 1; line-heights given in px (size × the CSS ratio) or 'normal' where the CSS leaves it unset

tokens.name: bg-page
tokens.usage: The page behind the Files canvas: the brand cream in Cream, near-black (not the brand ink) in Ink. The canvas itself is transparent over it.

tokens.name: bg-backdrop
tokens.usage: Window backdrop and the seams around floating chrome: the 6.4px seam shadow above the pinned path bar and below the action bar, and the fade strip under the path bar.

tokens.name: dot-grid
tokens.usage: Dots of the canvas grid: 0.96px dots on a 19.2px grid, drawn behind the whole Files page.

tokens.name: bg-card
tokens.usage: Menus, the Properties dialog, the consent and archive dialogs, the drop card. The slider thumb's ring.

tokens.name: bg-elevated
tokens.usage: Menu-item hover, the Properties thumbnail box, secondary dialog buttons. In Cream also the box behind a rendered preview on a tile. In Ink previews have no box.

tokens.name: chrome-glass
tokens.usage: The path bar once pinned to the top, and the bottom action bar, always with a 6.4px backdrop blur. Transparent while the path bar still scrolls with the page.

tokens.name: item-fill
tokens.usage: Hovered and selected tile or list row. The one fill an item ever takes; there is no hover lift.

tokens.name: control-fill
tokens.usage: Search field at rest.

tokens.name: control-fill-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on path-bar buttons, the search field and the category toggle. Also the category count pill and the search clear button.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: 1px hairline on menus, dialogs, the search field and toolbar separators. Also the rule after a category heading.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Tile and row edge on hover, search hover, the size-slider track, the context-menu edge.

tokens.name: border-flat
tokens.usage: The 1.5px edge of the frosted bars (pinned path bar, action bar). Opaque on purpose: an alpha hairline over blurred content reads uneven.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: File and folder names, the page title, the current breadcrumb, dialog titles, Properties values.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Breadcrumbs that aren't current, column headers, toolbar button labels, the masthead summary line, the full path in Properties.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Date, Type and Size columns, category headings, the action-bar status ('3 selected'), empty-state text, placeholders and the Ctrl F hint, crumb separators at 55% opacity.

tokens.name: text-on-accent
tokens.usage: Label on an accent-filled button (Choose folder, Enable AI search).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Cognac in Cream, sand in Ink. Selection border, focused search border, drop targets, the masthead eyebrow, active toggles, the primary button. In Cream, icons and the path-bar view/size/category controls use the Ink value (see icon-accent).

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on an accent-filled button.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Body of the identity-record glyph.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: The 2.4px ring around a selected item, the drop-target wash (tile, row, breadcrumb, whole canvas while files are dragged in), the focused search field, the active Select toggle.

tokens.name: icon-accent
tokens.usage: Every icon and file glyph, in both themes: folders, breadcrumb icons, file-type glyphs, the view, size and category controls. Icons wear the Ink palette even in Cream so a folder is the same sand everywhere. Text stays cognac.

tokens.name: hit-highlight
tokens.usage: Background of the matched words in a content-search snippet.

tokens.name: drop-wash
tokens.usage: Fill of the drop overlay while files from the computer are dragged over the canvas; its 1.6px dashed edge is the accent at 60%.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: The trash count badge, the red edge when an item is dragged onto the trash, a trash countdown in its last 3 days, delete confirmations.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Label of destructive menu items (Delete, Delete folder, Empty trash).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Countdown ring and hover chip on an item in the trash: days left before it's removed for good (30-day retention).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Not used by the Files tab itself; listed because the theme defines it.

tokens.name: overlay-scrim
tokens.usage: Behind the Properties and AI-consent dialogs. The archive prompt uses it at 32%.

tokens.name: folder-default
tokens.usage: Folder glyph with no colour chosen. Filled when the folder has contents, outlined when empty.

tokens.name: folder-red
tokens.usage: Folder colour preset (right-click a folder). Saved per project.

tokens.name: folder-orange
tokens.usage: Folder colour preset.

tokens.name: folder-amber
tokens.usage: Folder colour preset.

tokens.name: folder-green
tokens.usage: Folder colour preset.

tokens.name: folder-teal
tokens.usage: Folder colour preset.

tokens.name: folder-blue
tokens.usage: Folder colour preset.

tokens.name: folder-violet
tokens.usage: Folder colour preset.

tokens.name: folder-pink
tokens.usage: Folder colour preset.

tokens.name: office-word
tokens.usage: Word badge ('W') on the document glyph, and the 6px left stripe on a rendered .doc/.docx preview (3px in a list row).

tokens.name: office-excel
tokens.usage: Excel badge ('X') and preview stripe.

tokens.name: office-powerpoint
tokens.usage: PowerPoint badge ('P') and preview stripe.

tokens.name: office-pdf
tokens.usage: PDF badge ('PDF') and preview stripe.

tokens.name: office-page
tokens.usage: The white page behind an Office or text-file glyph, with a 0.8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.16) outline. White in both themes: it's a picture of paper.

tokens.name: ext-pill-bg
tokens.usage: Extension pill ('MD', 'TXT') in the corner of a text or unknown-format tile. Same in both themes, with ext-pill-text on it.

tokens.name: ext-pill-text
tokens.usage: Extension pill label.

tokens.name: whatsapp
tokens.usage: WhatsApp chat exports: glyph gradient from #25D366 to #128C7E at 135°, white logo. Only on WhatsApp exports.

tokens.name: media-scrim
tokens.usage: Round play button over a video thumbnail (1.6px blur). The duration badge uses rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6) with a 4.8px blur. White glyph and text on both.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: The masthead title: 'Files', the open folder's name, or 'Trash'. One per page; it scrolls away under the path bar.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: Heading of the AI-search invitation in search results.

styles.name: dialog-title
styles.sample: AI search sends this folder’s contents to Anthropic
styles.usage: Title of a consent or confirm dialog. The Properties dialog uses 12px, the archive prompt 12.8px.

styles.name: empty-title
styles.usage: Empty and loading states: 'Nothing here yet', 'Trash is empty', 'No matches'.

styles.name: glyph-letter
styles.usage: Letters on a file glyph at the default tile size (6.4px in a list row). Office badges use 800 and draw a thin white stroke behind the letter.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.sample: PROJECT FILES · STORED IN YOUR LOCAL FOLDER
styles.usage: Masthead eyebrow in accent. Its tail ('· Stored in your local folder', '· Home › Contracts', '· Recycle bin') is weight 500 in text-muted.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: The summary line under the title, in text-secondary.

styles.name: crumb
styles.usage: Breadcrumbs in the path bar. The root is 600 and the current folder 700, both in text-primary.

styles.name: item-name
styles.usage: Name under a tile: centred, two lines at most, the extension shown and styled like the name. In a list row it is weight 500 on one line.

styles.name: column-header
styles.usage: List-view column headings, in text-secondary.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: The Date, Type and Size columns of a list row, in text-muted. Content-search snippets use the same size at 1.4 line height.

styles.name: category-head
styles.usage: Group heading when files are grouped by category, followed by a count pill and a hairline.

styles.name: control
styles.usage: Action-bar buttons, the search field text, Create-menu items. An active toggle (Select → Done) is 600.

styles.name: menu-item
styles.usage: Right-click menu items, in text-primary (danger-soft for destructive ones).

styles.name: tooltip
styles.usage: The cursor-following hint pill, which a right-click turns into the menu. It never wraps.

styles.name: status
styles.usage: The action bar's status on the right, in text-muted.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels in the Properties dialog, in text-muted, beside 10.4px values.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Pick a folder on your computer — that’s where this project’s files live.
styles.usage: Empty-state text (max 304px wide), dialog body copy (10.8px there).

styles.name: kbd
styles.usage: The shortcut hint inside the search field, in text-muted; '⌘ F' on a Mac.

styles.name: ext-pill
styles.usage: The extension pill on a text or unknown-format tile.

styles.name: count-badge
styles.usage: The red count on the trash tile, white on danger.

styles.name: path
styles.usage: A file's location in the Properties dialog, in text-secondary. The only monospace on the page.

tokens.name: chrome-inset
tokens.usage: The gap every floating bar keeps from the window and the sidebar rail. Also the sticky offset of the path bar and the action bar's distance from the bottom.

tokens.name: content-left-gap
tokens.usage: Left edge of the page content from the sidebar rail: masthead, grid and list all start here.

tokens.name: grid-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between tiles, and between tiles and category sections.

tokens.name: tile-padding
tokens.usage: Inside a tile; 6.4px between thumbnail and name.

tokens.name: tile-size-min
tokens.usage: Smallest item size on the size slider. Below 100px the canvas switches to the list view.

tokens.name: tile-size-default
tokens.usage: Default tile width (list view defaults to 70). Thumbnail = 58% of the width, file glyph = 65% square, folder glyph = 112% of the thumbnail.

tokens.name: tile-size-max
tokens.usage: Largest tile width. The slider moves in 2px steps, Ctrl + wheel in 14px steps.

tokens.name: list-row
tokens.usage: List-row height, set by the same slider: thumbnail 19→40.8px, vertical padding 4.5→12px across the 70–98 range. Columns: Name (1.6fr) · Date 112px · Type 72px · Size 80px.

tokens.name: pathbar-height
tokens.usage: Minimum height of the path bar (padding 6.4px, 1.5px edge). All its controls are 24px tall.

tokens.name: control-size
tokens.usage: View and category toggles (24 × 24), back/forward (22.4 × 24), the search field height.

tokens.name: search-width
tokens.usage: Search field at rest; 288px while focused (the width eases open).

tokens.name: actionbar-padding
tokens.usage: Inside the bottom action bar. Buttons: padding 5.6px 8.8px, about 26px tall, 3.2px apart. Separators: 1 × 17.6px.

tokens.name: masthead-padding
tokens.usage: Around the eyebrow, title and summary line (14.4px between them).

tokens.name: menu-item-padding
tokens.usage: Right-click menu item. The menu is at least 160px wide, 3.2px padding, 1.6px between items.

tokens.name: dialog-width
tokens.usage: Properties dialog (the archive prompt is 268px, the AI consent 420px). Properties rows: a 73.6px label column, 8px gap.

tokens.name: empty-padding
tokens.usage: Empty-state block: 44.8px icon at 50% opacity, 11.2px below it.

tokens.name: icon-inline
tokens.usage: Action-bar icons. Path-bar icons are 14px, the root breadcrumb 16px, search 15px, category headings 13px.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: The page frame, the canvas and the list itself. Content sits flush; only items and chrome are rounded.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Path-bar buttons, the search field, action-bar buttons, list-row thumbnails, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-crumb
tokens.usage: Breadcrumbs, tile thumbnails, Create-menu items, search-hit thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-glyph
tokens.usage: File-type glyph tiles, dialog buttons, search-hit rows.

tokens.name: radius-item
tokens.usage: A tile, a list row's highlight, menus and the right-click menu.

tokens.name: radius-bar
tokens.usage: The path bar, the action bar, the drop card, the Properties thumbnail.

tokens.name: radius-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the drop overlay.

tokens.name: radius-confirm
tokens.usage: The red delete-confirmation pill.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Tooltip, count badges, the extension pill, colour swatches, the slider track, the video play button. Never a button with a text label.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: A hovered tile or list row. The only shadow an item takes.

tokens.name: shadow-elev
tokens.usage: Menus, dialogs, the drop card.

tokens.name: shadow-menu
tokens.usage: The right-click menu (both themes). The hint pill it grows from: 0 3.2px 9.6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4).

tokens.name: ring-selected
tokens.usage: Outside ring of a selected or drop-target item, with a 1px accent border.

tokens.name: seam
tokens.usage: Solid seam that makes the floating bars read as cut out of the window rather than floating over content: upward for the path bar, downward for the action bar.

tokens.name: glass-blur
tokens.usage: Backdrop blur of the pinned path bar, the action bar and the search field.

tokens.name: button-press-edge
tokens.usage: The bottom edge under an accent-filled button.

tokens.name: item
tokens.usage: Tile and row fill, border and shadow; breadcrumb hover; menu-item hover. Default easing.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Path-bar buttons, the slider, the search field's colours, action-bar buttons.

tokens.name: expand
tokens.usage: The search field widening, and the hint pill morphing into the right-click menu.

tokens.name: chrome
tokens.usage: The path bar's frosted surface fading in as it pins.

tokens.name: wash
tokens.usage: The canvas tint while files are dragged in, the action bar's surface.

tokens.name: dismiss
tokens.usage: The right-click menu closing.

tokens.name: dialog-in
tokens.usage: Properties dialog entering from 4.8px lower at 98% scale.

tokens.name: follow
tokens.usage: The hint pill following the cursor.

tokens.name: reduced-motion
tokens.usage: With reduced motion on, entrances and the pointer-following glows are removed and the loading spinner slows to 2s. Colour changes stay instant during a theme switch.
